strings: r_c0 helps m_c calm down, giving {PRONOUN/m_c/object} something smaller to focus on rather than the Clan as a whole.
The world is too much for m_c, overwhelmingly loud, bright and just everything all at once.
m_c feels frantic, as if {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} drowning in all the overwhelming sensations of the world around {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
With a distressed yowl, m_c recoils back into the medicine den, shaking {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head and complaining that the world is just too much.
